title: Global usage cut: cap concurrent sessions, cheaper context-relay model, fresh session per task
body: Source: operator 2026-11-16, Claude Code usage-insight panel pasted verbatim, with the order (verbatim): "prosze ogarnij to globalnie, to jest serio bardzo ważne szefunciu tuż po tym jak ogarniesz to wszystko!"

Panel (verbatim):
82%  Run fewer sessions at once · up to 23 at once
25%  Start fresh when you switch tasks · run /clear
15%  Run /context-relay on a cheaper model
13%  Check which model "context-relay" subagents use
11%  See what fills your context · run /context

Outcome: a global fix (user scope: ~/.claude, global skills, KRN lane/launcher defaults), not a per-repo patch:
1. A global cap on concurrent agent sessions/lanes, enforced by the launcher and lane start, with the measured peak (23) as the baseline to cut.
2. context-relay and its subagents run on a cheaper model (pin the model in the skill/agent frontmatter); verify which model they run on today from transcripts.
3. A fresh session on task switch (lead loop: one task per session, or /clear at slice boundary) rather than carrying context across tasks.
4. Evidence: the same usage panel, or ledger-derived numbers, before and after.
Interacts with t-v9zxepq (a larger context window raises per-turn cost): decide them together.

Proof: the Claude Code usage panel or a ledger query shows the peak of concurrent sessions and the context-relay model share dropping after the change
Files: ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/skills/context-relay/SKILL.md, scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts, src/lane/

Lead notes 2026-11-16 (advisor critique; do this first):
- Measure before designing: the panel's shares sum to 146%, so they are overlapping attributions, not savings. Script under .krn/runs/lead/usage/ (also the before/after Proof): from ~/.claude/projects transcripts of the last 7 days, tokens and cache reads by project, session kind (interactive, relay successor, Agent-tool subagent, lane) and model; concurrency per 5-minute bucket and what makes up the peak (operator sessions across projects vs KRN lanes/subagents); context-relay turns with context size, model and Agent calls after them; subagent model actually run vs `model:` in agent frontmatter and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL.
- Facts so far: 14 live `claude` processes across ~10 projects at 13:00; KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE defaults to 8 (src/cli/lane.ts:109); relay successors run Opus (the lead's real work); switching the relay skill's model inline at 250k would re-read the whole context uncached (costlier); `successor-launch --retire` kept 4 tabs (t1g, t1h, t1j, t1r).
- Constraints: hard-cap only what KRN launches (lane start, successor-launch, lead Agent lanes); never a refusing global hook over the operator's other projects. context-relay comes from rekurencja-skills and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md may be installed: edit their sources, not the installed copies. A lane cap changes KRN-13 and the delivery-lead "every independent ready task" line in the same PR; update memories parallel-lanes-default, light-tasks-cheap-models, successor-model-effort with the operator's verbatim order.
- Outdated instructions found by audit (operator order, verbatim: "wszystkie outadted instrukcje rowniez ogarnij"): docs/program/repository-workflow.md:54 names a `$delivery-loop` skill that does not exist; docs/program/lead-rules.md:21 links PLAN.md#working-plans (gone; the plan is docs/program/plan.md, ADR 0024); CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is `sonnet` globally and `claude-sonnet-5-5` in the krn repo .claude/settings.json (pick one source).

Measurement 2026-11-16 (script .krn/runs/lead/usage/measure.ts --from 2026-11-09T00:00Z --to 2026-11-16T14:00Z; frozen report .krn/runs/lead/usage/report-before-v3.md): 5,414 USD-eq in 7 days. Relay-chain links (657 sessions, 564 outside KRN, the operator's autonomous chains) 2,616 USD (48%); successor start-up (first 5 turns) 310 USD (5.7%); KRN lanes plus eval fleet about 7%; subagent model deviations 124 USD (2.3%); Fable as main model 733 USD in 106 successors before the 2026-11-16 global model: opus switch; advisor on Fable about 292 USD. Interval concurrency peak 69 (2026-11-12, d23 headless eval sessions, no launcher in the repo); ordinary-day peaks 26-28, nearly all machine-started. context-relay: 92% of 629 invocations are skill loads in a successor's first 5 turns (p50 context 50k), so pinning a cheaper model on the skill is the wrong lever (disposition: not done).
Delivered in the usage-cut PR: KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE default 8 -> 4 with KRN-13, lead-rules and delivery-lead updated; a krn-lane call naming opus or fable runs the pinned model unless the brief opts in with `lane-model:`; delivery-lead and KRN-13 start an unrelated task in a fresh session above 100k context.
Not cappable unattended: the operator's concurrent relay chains across projects (parked as a decision task).
Proof (amended; the panel's context-relay share cannot move): `node .krn/runs/lead/usage/measure.ts --from 2026-11-17T00:00Z --to 2026-11-24T00:00Z` against report-before-v3.md: KRN-launched lane concurrency peak <= 4, krn-lane opus/fable launches without lane-model == 0, Fable-main successors == 0. Re-run on or after 2026-11-24; close then.

Proof correction (advisor review): the lane cap binds krn lane start worktrees only; the eval-fleet peak is capped by the follow-up eval session-cap task. After-proof criteria: krn-lane opus/fable launches without lane-model == 0, Fable-main successors == 0, peak live lane worktrees <= 4; total concurrency is reported, not gated. The 100k fresh-session rule sits below the 200k first advisory of t-v9zxepq by design (an unrelated task, not a relay); its break-even is an estimate (turn cost at 100k+ vs ~0.5 USD successor start), to be checked in the after-run.

Proof amendment 2026-11-18 (lead, drift audit): fe9f10b (t-n1k2ccq, operator-approved, quota checked) raised KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE to 6 (src/cli/lane.ts:120). The after-proof lane criterion is now: peak live lane worktrees <= KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE (6); the other criteria are unchanged.
Operator 2026-11-19: S8 A/B/C is the priority after the host-capacity line and t-k7xx0kq. Lowered to P1: not on the S8 path.
